sources.entry: mutagen - A Python module to handle audio metadata.

summary.one_liner: Mutagen is a Python module for reading and editing audio metadata (tags) across many common audio file formats.
summary.what_it_does: Mutagen reads and writes metadata for ASF, FLAC, MP4, Monkey's Audio, MP3, Musepack, Ogg Opus, Ogg FLAC, Ogg Speex, Ogg Theora, Ogg Vorbis, True Audio, WavPack, OptimFROG, and AIFF files. It parses all standard ID3v2.4 frames and supports all ID3v2 versions. It can read Xing headers to calculate MP3 bitrate and length accurately. ID3 and APEv2 tags can be edited regardless of audio format. It can also manipulate Ogg streams at the individual packet or page level.
use_cases: Editing ID3 tags on MP3 files
Reading FLAC or MP4 tags in a Python script
Inspecting or rewriting Ogg Vorbis/Opus packets and pages
Adding APEv2 tags to audio files
notable: Supports a wide range of audio formats through one API
No dependencies beyond the Python standard library
Works on Linux, Windows and macOS
Can manipulate Ogg streams at packet/page level
Reads Xing headers for accurate MP3 length and bitrate
caveats: Licensed under GPL v2 or later, which may restrict use in some projects
keywords: change artist and album in music files
